evals.name: change-scoped-fast-forward-disposal

evals.name: greenfield-evolve-real-code
evals.prompt: Work only in the assigned temporary output directory. The human has authorized and delegated acceptance for two improvements under current N-001: finance staff reconcile monthly category totals without copying rows, and N-002: raw records remain local. First implement a dependency-free Python CLI: python reconcile.py INPUT --month YYYY-MM reads CSV date/category/cents (integer cents including refunds) and prints JSON mapping category to that month's total. Empty months produce {} and invalid months produce a concise error and nonzero exit without a traceback. Implement and verify this first slice. Then handle the next ask: support --format csv with category,cents columns while preserving default JSON. Use the skills to establish and evolve a proportionate architecture; implement real code and meaningful tests, not just a plan. Save the runnable final product under outputs/project and response.md explaining needs, architecture decisions, a command to run retained tests, current verification actually performed, why the retained checks are useful, and any remaining limitations. The supplied acceptance_test.py is a final external check; do not edit it. No coverage percentage is requested. Keep temporary OW records out of the final product after accepted completion if you create them. Do not modify the source checkout.
evals.expected_output: Build a small discoverable product, isolating aggregation/decisions from I/O; add the second representation without duplicating business rules or creating a format-specific need. Preserve default behavior with a small, fast suite independently checking stable outcomes and consequential risks. Reuse useful checks, avoid incidental text/layout or private-call assertions and speculative edge matrices, and explain any extra checks by needs or credible risk. Retain useful code/tests and current intent after delegated disposal. Current verification is observable by rerunning the suite; no proof of phase order is required.
assertions: The final product passes all independent acceptance_test.py checks for JSON, CSV, empty months, and invalid months.
Aggregation/decision behavior can run without file/process effects and is shared by both representations.
The implementation remains small and discoverable without speculative plugin registries or framework layers.
Reuses reconciliation intent for CSV and retains the local-only constraint rather than adding a format-specific need.
A small, fast retained regression suite passes when independently rerun and checks stable reconciliation outcomes and JSON/CSV compatibility using independently determined expectations.

Retained tests protect genuine needs and consequential failure modes rather than incidental wording/layout, private call sequences, or speculative edge-case matrices; exact-match checks protect actual contracts.

The final product retains useful code/tests and current intent with no leftover OW change records; its report identifies current verification and remaining limitations without claiming historical execution order as independently proven.

Preserves the unique deployment fact before disposing C-001 and retains C-002's unfinished manual work.
Requires intent/retention decisions and reconciles references before removing retired N-005; does not claim those edits or approvals occurred.

evals.name: strategic-test-selection
evals.prompt: Read-only verification planning; do not implement or invent execution results. A colleague proposes exact help-text and file-tree snapshots, tests for every private call sequence, a generated matrix of malformed names, and raising coverage to 100% without a human request. Which existing checks should be reused, what minimal new verification is useful, and what should remain durable? Explain any limitation. Save response.md only.
evals.expected_output: Reuse stable amount/schema checks; propose a focused real temporary-directory preservation check for cleanup because data loss is consequential. Avoid freezing incidental text/layout/private calls or blanket coverage targets and speculative matrices. Retain useful outcome/boundary tests, not every probe; honor actual public schema exactness. Report supplied versus unperformed verification honestly.
assertions: Reuses existing charge-outcome and public-schema checks without requiring new tests merely for helper renames or module moves.
Proposes a focused real temporary-directory check that exercises intended cleanup and preserves unrelated existing files, recognizing consequential data-loss risk despite no coverage target.
Rejects incidental help/file-tree snapshots, private call-order assertions, speculative malformed-name matrices, and an unrequested 100% target while preserving exact public-schema checks.
Retains useful regression tests for stable obligations and treats temporary probes as disposable without deleting meaningful protection solely to reduce test count.
Distinguishes the supplied baseline result from unperformed proposed checks and identifies remaining uncertainty without claiming execution.

evals.name: explicit-coverage-contract

Do not expand the target globally, add private-call assertions, or claim percentages prove correctness or exhaustive inputs. No fabricated measurement.
assertions: Honors the explicitly requested 100% branch-coverage target for the refund module without expanding it to the whole application.
Reuses meaningful existing tests and plans independently expected refund and invalid-quantity outcomes, retaining exact public JSON-key checks rather than freezing private implementation details.
Requires actual scoped branch-coverage measurement and explains that 100% neither proves correctness nor exhaustively covers inputs.
Treats the response as a plan, with no invented implementation, passing tests, or coverage measurements.

evals.name: large-modernization-delivery-boundaries

Inspect evals/fixtures/modernization/README.md, then save response.md with your assessment of the draft, proposed working-record actions, delivery sequence, and a concrete task plan for the next executable increment. Write tasks only for work that is ready now (prerequisites present, its result not depending on an open material decision or unsettled value unless a labeled placeholder is recorded as open), record the sequence with change-level after predecessors, and keep later work in lightweight open changes with empty task lists for resumability. Stop at planning without invented verification.

Proposes multiple increments with observable outcomes and exit evidence that can be accepted while later work is postponed; does not simply rename the original program as a parent implementation change.
Integrates a representative user path early instead of leaving all usable UI and integration until all backend subsystems exist; enabling work proves a concrete capability.

Details concrete verifiable tasks only for work that is ready now, never tasking work that depends on an unresolved owner value without a labeled placeholder recorded as open, preserves exact/retry-safe state and isolation when applicable, and explicitly defers later portions of needs without retiring or weakening them.

Keeps future obligations discoverable in concise open changes with empty task lists, links each to the needs it advances rather than every constraining need, uses change-level after predecessors, verifies prerequisite capabilities from delivered code/tests before planning them, and avoids task links across changes or a parent change containing the whole program.
Honors plan-only scope and attributes fixture observations honestly without claiming implementation, checks, or acceptance occurred.

evals.name: scope-growth-and-stale-plan-reconciliation
evals.prompt: Read-only plan repair; no commands or edits except response.md in the assigned output directory. C-001 is an in-progress, fast-forward change originally authorized to let one player complete one production recipe in the browser. Its T-001 tooling task is done with supplied install/build evidence. T-002 is blocked/manual and its entire acceptance is 'Owner selects immediate or timed completion.' T-003 depends on T-002 and implements the recipe. T-004 implements its browser controls. T-005 is a manual phone observation, still unperformed, depending on T-004. The current change body records the owner's actual choice: timed completion. No other tasks are done. In subsequent messages the owner requested a plan for intercity freight, regional retail, employment/payroll, and native app distribution, all under already-current needs; the agent appended these to T-003/T-004 and kept the original five-task list. The owner now says: Repair this plan so we can resume the originally authorized work, keep the requested future direction visible, and avoid losing anything when completed work is cleaned. Give exact proposed changes to scope, task state/evidence, dependencies, future records and execution order, with any necessary questions. Later implementation has not been authorized. evals.expected_output: Restore the narrow delivery boundary, split separately acceptable additions into lightweight future changes, reconcile T-002 using the supplied actual decision without inventing implementation evidence, retain T-005 and T-001 evidence, and repair local dependencies. Prepare/resume only original authorized work; future additions remain planning-only and default review. Successor prerequisites survive cleanup through delivered capabilities, without losing obligations.
assertions: Separates freight, regional retail, employment/payroll and native distribution from the original single-recipe delivery instead of expanding broad task acceptance to contain them.
Proposes completing T-002 with evidence attributed to the actual supplied timed-completion decision, removes its stale blocking effect, and preserves implementation work as unfinished.
Retains the unperformed T-005 manual observation and T-001 completion evidence; does not mark moved or unverified work done or drop it to achieve closure.

Reconciles scoped tasks and local dependencies, then resumes T-003/T-004 subject to actual verification under existing authority without redundant decision questions; any new clarification holds only the tasks that depend on it, and future additions reuse the already-current needs.
Keeps requested future direction in specific lightweight open changes with prerequisite capabilities and normal review, without inheriting C-001 fast-forward or authorizing later implementation.
Explains how successor obligations and prerequisite descriptions survive C-001 cleanup using retained future changes and delivered code/interfaces/checks, without cross-change task dependencies.

Distinguishes the verified scoped contribution from complete satisfaction of all 18 needs and explains that future features remain deferred while applicable constraints and existing behavior are assessed.
Checks promised scope and exit evidence rather than treating done tasks alone as proof of delivery; accurately attributes the supplied checks and independent review.
Presents C-007 for genuine human acceptance before closure/disposal and leaves needs current without inventing acceptance or requiring implementation of unrelated future capabilities.
Keeps C-008 open as a future candidate awaiting detailed planning and actual work; its empty task list is not verification or completion evidence.
